baseStrategy: No automatic Summer shorts; unchanged inherited Summer signal thresholds/sizing and Winter targets. Threshold nomination uses Summer-only portfolios with fallback in Winter.
rule: Suppress Summer gas long iff storageSurplusPct > storageThresholdPct AND productionYoYChangeBcfd - lngYoYChangeBcfd > flowThresholdBcfd. Equality does not suppress. All released exposure returns to the index fallback. Missing required inputs are invalid, not a numeric zero.

family.quantileDefinition: Linear interpolation, sorted positive values, index=(n-1)*q; retain exact computed thresholds; identical numerical pairs collapse.
family.featureSample: Unique causally available storage period-end reports and unique STEO release vintages observed on May-September trading sessions in2021-2023. Values determined without reading portfolio returns. A report can enter distribution only if available before that session open.

costs: Exactly frozen baseline scenario selects; elevated/stress are report-only. Existing causal adjusted-open execution,2% cash buffer,80/20 VOO/QQQM fallback, deadband and borrow conventions remain.

uncertainty.method: Paired circular block bootstrap on chronological training daily log-return differences against zero/zero, using identical resampled indices for every candidate. Simultaneous two-sided max-t confidence bands across nonzero threshold cells; centered-bootstrap single-step family-adjusted one-sided p-values also reported. Block-bootstrap standard deviation estimates standard error of mean.

selection.default: zero/zero: interpretable economic sign boundaries, not a fitted optimum
replacementRequirements: Simultaneous90% lower band for training mean daily log-return excess versus zero/zero strictly positive.
Positive aggregate after-cost training excess versus both unfiltered no-shorts and fallback.
At least2of3 training calendar years have positive after-cost excess versus both unfiltered no-shorts and fallback.

At least10 affected baseline-gas episodes after merging any separated by fewer than10 flat trading sessions; minimum is a conservative preregistered sufficiency heuristic, not a universal statistical law.
selection.plateauRule: Among eligible cells within one paired-block standard error of the training-best eligible mean log return, choose smallest sum of grid indices, then smaller storage index, then smaller flow index. These are simpler/closer-to-zero boundaries.
selection.validation: Freeze training nomination before computing2024 results. Report whether chosen thresholds improve2024 after-cost returns versus zero/zero, unfiltered no-shorts, and fallback. No challenger substitution or retuning from validation; failed validation means unsupported optimization, with zero/zero the stated operational fallback. This never blocks existing paper operation.
selection.holdout: 2025 is reporting-only and must not change nominee, validation interpretation, or fallback.
selection.fallback: If no cell meets replacement requirements, state no statistically supported best threshold identified and retain zero/zero as user-chosen economic convention. No global optimality claim.

limitations: Historical Summer weather uses legacy hours-0; current live uses corrected four-sample statistic.
Inherited thresholds and historical data were seen during earlier research, including2025 and the recent episode. This study excludes2024-2026 from current fitting, not from all prior development.
Only three training summers; overlapping exposures and monthly STEO vintages limit independent sample size. Bootstrap approximations do not create missing independent observations.
Production-minus-LNG growth is a partial supply-pressure proxy, not total gas supply/demand balance; other demand, pipeline trade, and future market expectations are omitted.
Storage historical observations may be revised; STEO monthly values are contemporaneously released estimates and admit only after stated release date.
This research protocol does not modify or suspend paper trading.
